comparator.sourceNotes: The programme-specific Appendix I 2026–2027, printed pages 55–59 and cohort 9A201-2026, supplies the ordinary English full-time Tilburg sequence: 60 EC in each of three years. Every named course is represented separately; the third-year 30-EC mobility/minor window remains genuine open space. Old Testament: Torah and Prophetic Literature (U20074-B-6) carries 6 EC in the formal cohort table, correcting the general webpage's 3-EC display; there is no missing three-credit unit. Research and academic skills (12 EC) are embedded in named course weights and are not additional credit. Yellow-coded compulsory units rotate every two years and appear once in the specified cohort sequence. Ordinary Hebrew, Greek and Latin requirements are retained; Greek exemptions and replacement of Latin for an intended teacher-training master require the stated conditions/Board permission and are alternatives, not extra components. The merged registry target covers English Tilburg and Dutch Utrecht delivery plus part-time pacing. English full-time is an ordinary representative delivery, not an English-only target inferred from its translated name. The public reader was recorded as published on 14 September 2026; its general body retains a stale 2025–2026 effective-date clause, so the explicitly dated 2026 cohort appendix controls this reconstruction. Appendix and external allocation checked 2026-10-08; the external allocation and source conflict were rechecked on 2026-10-14; the settled comparator remains unchanged while the UCR judgment is independently reassessed. Fresh 31 October 2026 direct retrieval of the dated Appendix I confirms the September2026 cohort table (PDF page58/105), mandatory/rotating rules(page59), disciplinary objectives/pages53–54, ordinary structure/pages55–57, and optional minors/pages60–61. U20074-B-6 is6EC, not the webpage3EC. Sequentiality states not applicable; language replacements/exemptions remain conditional, not assumed. Skills12EC are embedded. No source failure remains: the web reader could not open the attachment, but direct official retrieval succeeded. Ordinary English full-time delivery remains a neutral representative of the merged target, not a separate religion-and-worldviews route.

routeSelection.basis: The normalized target combines ordinary English Tilburg and Dutch Utrecht deliveries and full-/part-time modes. The ordinary English full-time Tilburg delivery provides an explicitly dated September 2026 cohort sequence for the same broad Theology bachelor, without selecting a shortened prior-degree pathway or the optional canonical-degree package. Translation of the registry display name does not establish an exclusive English target; delivery choice is independent of UCR fit.

exception.reason: UCR offers real study of philosophical questions about God and meaning, comparative myths, religious art and material culture, and ethics. A strengthened combination of these courses still does not sustain inquiry into theological sources, Christian faith and its interpretation, lived religious practice and the relationship between religious tradition and contemporary church and society that defines this bachelor. General cultural interpretation and public ethics provide relevant connections but do not together establish a defensible Theology programme.
exception.curriculumContext: Complete34-component180EC ordinary September2026 English full-time route verified from dated formal appendix. Each year60EC; genuine mobility30 and Theology thesis9. Source-language exemptions/replacements conditional, skills12 embedded, rotating courses counted once. No unresolved external evidence.
exception.ucrCourseEvidence: All151active course identities and available evidence screened for religion/theology/scripture/spirituality/Christianity/Islam/Buddhism/ritual/myth;36original courses and relevant alternatives read substantively. Strongest24-course attempt adds Western Art History, Philosophy of Mind and Native American Histories to myth, African religious art/heritage, archaeology, ancient democracy/religion, philosophical God/self/agency, literature and social/ethical inquiry. Genuine religious contributions acknowledged, including creation myths, Hindu/Near Eastern narratives, Buddhist self-theory, religious material culture and Western art. Their combined organising inquiry remains cultural/philosophical rather than sustained theological interpretation of faith and practice. No religious project/brief is assumed in free research. GOSHIST312 receives full description-only consideration as historical inquiry, not an archived case or church-history syllabus. Public law is not canon law; general sociology/psychology are not documented sociology/psychology of religion. Broader meaningful-life/justice signals do not replace the target with a personalised philosophy request. No equivalence rule, course quota, missing-language or professional-credential rule, or offering-based no-match.

candidateAssessment.concept: Belief, theology, religious traditions and worldviews
candidateAssessment.assessment: UCR offers real study of philosophical questions about God and meaning, comparative myths, religious art and material culture, and ethics. A strengthened combination of these courses still does not sustain inquiry into theological sources, Christian faith and its interpretation, lived religious practice and the relationship between religious tradition and contemporary church and society that defines this bachelor. General cultural interpretation and public ethics provide relevant connections but do not together establish a defensible Theology programme.

Ethical theory, human rights, constitutional law, social justice and environmental movements are real substantive inquiry. Secular public responsibility does not implement theological ethical interpretation merely because the target asks justice/tolerance questions. It cannot bypass failure of a defensible closest response.

The actual minor combines general pedagogy/didactics6, subject didactics6, school placement/intervision15 and education research3. Rhetoric in Action provides real primary-school public speaking and youth resilience provides educational prevention, but neither establishes religion/worldview didactics or a sustained education-and-religion programme. Qualification absence alone is not the reason.

Actual minor includes sin/grace, religion/humanism/AI, God/evil, contemporary ethics, churches/interreligious dialogue and canon law. Philosophical God/agency and AI ethics give genuine connections, without establishing the religious and theological inquiry. Not rejected only for lack of a canonical credential.

audience.programmeDescription: Theology at Tilburg University studies Christian faith and religious traditions through biblical studies, church history, philosophy, systematic and practical theology, spirituality and social sciences. The selected English full-time pathway includes source languages, a mobility window and a Theology thesis.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers genuine connections through philosophy, myth, religious art and heritage, ethics and social inquiry. These courses do not together provide sufficiently sustained theological study of faith, religious sources and practice for a meaningful programme comparison. The verified Tilburg curriculum is shown without a proposed UCR alternative.

curriculum.limitation: The September 2026 cohort follows a 180-EC sequence through 2028–2029, including 30 EC of approved mobility/minor choice and a required 9-EC Theology thesis. Rotating courses are counted once. Research and academic skills are embedded in course credits. Dutch delivery in Utrecht and part-time study are also available.
